input.explanation: The division by zero is in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py, in this repository, and the guard sits on that same line. Its callers here (`render_spend_summary`, and `_the_figure_for` and `serve_account_page` in src/io_shop/account_page.py) already render whatever int the function returns. So once this is deployed, shoppers with nothing bought this month will get a page with the flag on. Nothing outside this repository needs to change.
